subject.title: [Feature Request] Add config encryption for credentials at rest

question: Which credential-at-rest model should OpenClaw support for config, channel/gateway credentials, and provider auth profiles?
rationale: The affected code paths are clear, but choosing key custody, migration, recovery, rotation, unattended startup, and compatibility semantics is a security boundary decision that automation should not make.

options.title: Design native encrypted storage
options.body: Define a keychain or passphrase-backed storage model with explicit migration, recovery, rotation, and upgrade tests across config, SQLite auth profiles, backups, and SecretRefs.

options.title: Keep SecretRefs as mitigation
options.body: Document transparent native encryption as out of scope for now and focus this tracker on audit guidance, SecretRef migration coverage, and plaintext-residue cleanup.

options.title: Stage narrower sealing first
options.body: Land a scoped step such as auth-store sealing or keychain-backed SecretRef migration while keeping this issue open for the full at-rest strategy.

recommendation.title: Design native encrypted storage
recommendation.body: Define a keychain or passphrase-backed storage model with explicit migration, recovery, rotation, and upgrade tests across config, SQLite auth profiles, backups, and SecretRefs.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current-main history on the inspected auth-profile persistence, secrets docs, threat-model, config write, and partial sealing design paths.
